# Fix Customer Service — Abdullah Khan

> One-person customer service operations practice in Dubai, UAE, working with businesses worldwide. Abdullah Khan has built and run a customer service department in the UAE for seven years and now helps businesses fix their support: faster replies, lower cost per contact, fewer repeat questions, better reviews, and a team setup that scales without linear hiring.

## What this site offers
- A free 30-minute diagnostic call: the visitor's three biggest customer service problems, identified honestly
- A one-week "look": counting incoming messages, response times, missed enquiries, and cost
- A fixed-price "fix": shared inbox setup, automated answers to repeat questions, reply-time targets, complaint handling, team structure and training
- Optional monthly follow-up: reporting, quality checks, and tuning

## Who it is for
Businesses of any size and industry, from a few hundred to hundreds of thousands of customer messages a month. Based in Dubai; works remotely across the UAE and internationally.
